text:
Priya Chen: Quick sync — proposing a 6-week micro-sprint program for Design Partners to validate the Private Deployment onboarding flow. TL;DR: 6-week cohort, 6 partners, 2 feedback gates, weekly check-ins, 2 core success metrics (activation rate + 30-day retention).

Jorge Martinez: love the micro-sprint wording. can you sketch the gating criteria?

Priya Chen: yes — trying to keep things lightweight so partners don't drop out. proposed gates: Week 1 smoke (env + secrets + basic inference), Week 4 workload run (latency/cost + UX feedback). pass both -> recommend for pilot expansion.

Sam K: for Week 1 smoke, what's "pass" exactly? need concrete pass/fail so eng knows what to verify.

Priya Chen: good call. suggested pass checklist (short):
```
- NDA + low-risk data agreement signed
- VPC peering or creds in place
- Sample inference job runs w/ 95th p95 < 300ms for 512 tokens OR documented customer SLO waiver
- Ability to stream logs to our observability endpoint
```

Mei Li: pinging infra constraints — the p95 < 300ms is tricky for on-prem customers. can we allow model-variant routing as a fallback? e.g., quantized variant for pilot.

Ari Patel: +1 to fallback. also suggest we record which optimizations we applied (quant, batching, kernel flags) so we can replicate in Dedicated.

Jorge Martinez: scope negotiation note: some partners will ask for custom routing policies (region pinning, data residency). recommend we treat these as scope-adds and log them as "pilot asks" vs "must-haves".

Priya Chen: agreed. categorize asks into: Must (blockers for onboarding), Nice-to-have (can delay), Post-pilot (roadmap). We'll surface in the feedback doc.

Sam K: feedback cadence? weekly async survey + 30-min sync after gate fails/passes?

Priya Chen: exactly: weekly 5-question signal (NPS-lite) + one 30-min check-in at Week 2 and Week 5. If a gate fails, immediate 30-min triage + 24h remediation window for critical infra items.

Mei Li: how do we measure success quantitatively for the cohort? propose two metrics: Activation rate (partner completes Week1 pass within 10 days) and Pilot engagement (>=4 of 6 partners hit Week4 run). Also include qualitative: 4/5 satisfaction on onboarding docs.

Ari Patel: logs: please add a checkbox to require instrumentation of latency + cost per-request tagging. we need that to compute unit economics for Private.

Priya Chen: adding instrumentation to Week1 checklist. Also recommend a minimal eval harness we send partners: small prompt set + scoring script (we'll capture hallucination/regression).

Jorge Martinez: rollout plan for expanding successful partners -> Dedicated offering? what are the gating SLA numbers to propose to sales?

Priya Chen: propose internal default SLA targets post-pilot: 99.5% uptime for inference, p95 < 250ms on hosted equivalent, documented cost-per-1k-tokens for the deployed config. We can relax per-customer based on infra.

Sam K: incentives to recruit partners? small $3k credit + engineering hours (8h) and co-marketing for reference customers. keeps commitment low but valuable.

Mei Li: add "sandbox training" session in Week0 (30m) to reduce hand-holding. include a short checklist for partner engineers.

Priya Chen: here's the Week0 -> Week6 outline I'm proposing:
```
Week0: NDA, kickoff, sandbox training (30m), infra prep
Week1: smoke run + instrumentation (gate 1)
Week2: triage & optimization, check-in
Week3: feature-specific integration tests (auth, routing)
Week4: workload run + qualitative UX survey (gate 2)
Week5: iterate on regressions, collect final metrics
Week6: closeout, decision: expand / pause / handback
```

Ari Patel: love the structure. question: what's our decision authority for "expand"? PM + Eng + CS signoff?

Priya Chen: yes — default: PM + Eng lead + CS customer owner. we also include a short "risk register" for each partner (security, infra, legal).

Jorge Martinez: ops-bot FYI: can you create a tracker template in Confluence (or Notion) with the gates + checklist?

ops-bot: Created page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/dp-micro-sprint-template. Assigned: Priya (PM), Ari (Eng). :white_check_mark:

Sam K: next steps for recruitment: we'll target 10 outreach messages to existing beta-ready customers, shortlist 8, aim for 6 in cohort. Priya will own outreach copy.

Mei Li: add a short legal FAQ to reduce NDA friction (one pager).

Priya Chen: noted. I'll draft outreach + onboarding one-pager by EOD tomorrow. If everyone's good I'll post the recruitment copy here for quick edits. :thumbsup:

Jorge Martinez: 👍 ready to review once posted.

Ari Patel: +1. one micro-request: add a small prompt-set for perf vs quality tradeoff so partners can test quantized vs fp16.

Priya Chen: will add prompt-set and the scoring harness link. thanks all — will post the draft recruitment thread in this channel in ~12h.
